epics.title: orders: M0 Foundations
goals: FakeJev, the parse pipeline and the Orders HTTP API skeleton emit valid parse_result (orders-01)
Ticket-note eval set and scorer exist; wrong-without-question is the headline metric
Normalized-note parse cache works offline after the first parse
Vendor spikes written up: Jev (OQ-5), Cartesia Ink, Apify

epics.title: orders: M1 Vertical Slice
goals: Question flow with the send gate: /send refuses any draft with an open question (invariant 3)
Send writes ticket, ticket_constraint and ticket_exception through StateClient
Amendments write revision + 1 with the full constraint set (invariant 9)
Bin profiling and chef confirmation on FakeJev write bin_profile and chef_confirmation
Orders runs in the platform e2e harness, then against the partner's real database

epics.title: orders: M2 Live on Pi
goals: Orders service runs on the demo LAN against live SpacetimeDB
Shift-start profiling run with real bin labels
Latency budgets met: parse <= 3 s online, <= 50 ms cached

epics.title: orders: M3 Models
goals: Real Jev adapter scores the eval set at the owner's threshold with zero wrong constraints above threshold
Jev bin profiling from label photos and prep sheets, unclear items routed to chef confirmation
Cartesia Ink live behind Transcriber; transcript confirmed by the server before parsing

epics.title: orders: M4 Demo Hardening
goals: Offline mode: warm cache and manual-entry fallback with no internet
Failure drill: Jev down leads to questions or manual entry, never a guess
Optional: Apify menu import seeds prep sheets

tasks.title: orders: FakeJev, parse pipeline and Orders HTTP API skeleton
tasks.goal: A runnable orders service where POST /v1/parse turns a note into a valid parse_result using a deterministic FakeJev, and every other Orders HTTP API endpoint exists with its contract shape.
acceptance: FakeJev in kitchen/orders/jev.py implements JevClient.parse_note with a keyword parser covering the nine allergen units, severity words and 'traces'/'fine' phrasing: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k fake_jev` passes

kitchen/orders/parse.py normalizes the note and calls JevClient; kitchen/orders/questions.py adds a question for every field below question_threshold: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k pipeline_questions` passes

POST /v1/parse (kitchen/orders/api.py) returns JSON that validates against parse_result.schema.json for every note in kitchen/orders/tests/fixtures/notes_smoke.jsonl: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k api_parse_contract` passes
All other endpoints in contracts/apis.md#orders-http-api exist and return 501 with the standard error body; GET /v1/health returns 200: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k api_stubs` passes
CORS origins come from ORDERS_CORS_ORIGINS per contracts/apis.md#http-conventions, with no wildcard: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k cors` passes
Example responses for /v1/parse (ok, with questions) are written to kitchen/orders/fakes/http/ and validate: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k http_fakes_valid` passes
kitchen/orders/README.md documents how to run the service locally and the HTTP framework choice (FastAPI suggested)
out_of_scope: Any real Jev or vendor call

tasks.title: orders: Build the ticket-note eval set and scorer
tasks.goal: A labeled set of at least 60 ticket notes with expected constraints and exceptions, plus a scorer that reports per-field accuracy and the count of wrong constraints that were not turned into questions.
acceptance: kitchen/orders/eval/notes.jsonl has >= 60 notes, each with expected constraints, exceptions and an 'ambiguous' flag where a question is the right answer

Hard cases covered and tagged: 'no nuts' (peanut ambiguity), 'dairy-free but butter ok', negation ('not allergic to eggs'), misspellings ('seseme'), voice transcription errors ('says me' for sesame), several allergens in one note, severity words, 'traces are fine'
Scorer `uv run python -m kitchen.orders.evaluate` prints per-field accuracy and wrong_without_question, and exits non-zero when wrong_without_question > 0
Scorer runs against FakeJev once orders-01 lands; until then it is tested on a trivial stub parser: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k eval_scorer` passes
Every expected allergen ID exists in contracts/allergen_units.json: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k eval_units_known` passes
out_of_scope: Tuning FakeJev to pass the whole set

tasks.title: orders: Spike: verify what backs Jev and how to call it
tasks.goal: Answer OQ-5 for Jev as far as agents can: what model or service backs it, how to call it, cost, latency, offline story, and an adapter sketch for JevClient. Anything only the owner can supply goes to status:needs-human.
acceptance: kitchen/orders/docs/jev-spike.md answers: provider or model, auth, request/response shape, rate limits, cost per parse, observed or documented latency, offline options, and whether image input works for bin labels
Every claim cites its source (doc link or owner comment); unverified claims are marked as such
A proposed real-adapter design for kitchen/orders/jev.py that keeps the JevClient signature unchanged and lists the per-field confidence signal Jev can give
Questions for the owner are posted on the issue, which moves to status:needs-human if keys or a choice are needed
out_of_scope: Committing keys or sample responses containing keys

tasks.title: orders: Spike: verify Cartesia Ink and Apify menu import
tasks.goal: Document how Cartesia Ink speech-to-text and an Apify Actor for menu import would be called, so kitchen/orders/transcribe.py and kitchen/profiling/menu_import.py can be built later without guesswork.
acceptance: kitchen/orders/docs/vendor-spike.md covers Cartesia Ink (auth, audio formats, streaming vs batch, latency, cost, offline behavior) and Apify (which Actor, input/output shape, cost, run time)
Every claim cites its source; unverified claims are marked
Adapter sketches keep the Transcriber signature and the /v1/menu/import contract unchanged
Owner questions (keys, accounts) posted on the issue with status:needs-human if needed

tasks.title: orders: Add normalized-note parse cache with offline fallback
tasks.goal: Cache parse results by normalized note in kitchen/orders/cache.py, so a repeated note parses instantly and works offline, and make a cache miss with Jev unavailable fail clearly instead of guessing.
acceptance: Normalization rules (case, whitespace, punctuation, unicode) documented and unit-tested: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k normalize` passes
A second parse of the same note returns cached=true in <= 50 ms and survives a service restart: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k cache_hit_persists` passes
JevUnavailable with a cache hit returns the cached result: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k cache_offline_hit` passes
JevUnavailable with no cache hit returns error code jev_unavailable and writes nothing: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k cache_offline_miss -m safety` passes
The cache key includes parser name and version, so a parser upgrade never serves stale results: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k cache_versioned` passes

tasks.title: orders: Implement question answers and the send gate
tasks.goal: Answers fill their target fields, sendable flips only when every question is answered, and /send refuses any draft with an open question (invariant 3).
acceptance: POST /v1/drafts/{id}/answers fills the targeted constraint, exception or new constraint and returns an updated parse_result that validates: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k answers_fill_target` passes
POST /v1/drafts/{id}/send returns 409 unanswered_questions while any question is open: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k send_gate -m safety` passes

Property test (hypothesis): for arbitrary JevClient outputs, every field below question_threshold has a question after the pipeline runs, and send is refused until all are answered: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k send_gate_property -m safety` passes
A mentioned allergen at any confidence becomes a constraint or a question, never silently dropped: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k never_drop_mention -m safety` passes
Answering with a value not among the question's options returns 422: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k answers_invalid_option` passes
Example responses for answers and the 409 error are added to kitchen/orders/fakes/http/: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k http_fakes_valid` passes

tasks.title: orders: Apply sent tickets through StateClient
tasks.goal: A successful send writes the ticket, its constraints and exceptions through StateClient.put_ticket (kitchen/orders/apply.py), with pass_threshold set from the strictest severity on the ticket.
acceptance: Send calls put_ticket with a Ticket that validates against ticket.schema.json: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k apply_contract` passes against InMemoryStateClient
Default pass_threshold comes from the strictest severity using the OQ-4 defaults in one config object, logged at startup: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k apply_threshold_default` passes
StateUnavailable on put_ticket returns an error to the caller and the draft stays unsent: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k apply_state_down -m safety` passes
Sending the same draft twice does not create two tickets: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k apply_idempotent` passes
Example response for a successful send added to kitchen/orders/fakes/http/

tasks.title: orders: Support ticket amendments at revision + 1
tasks.goal: POST /v1/tickets/{id}/amend (kitchen/orders/amend.py) opens a new draft at revision + 1 that goes through the same question flow, and sending it writes a new revision with the full constraint set (invariant 9).
acceptance: Amend returns a parse_result draft pre-filled with the previous revision's constraints plus the new note's: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k amend_draft` passes
Sending the amendment writes revision + 1 with the complete constraint set; previous revision rows are untouched: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k amend_revision -m safety` passes
An amendment never removes a constraint without an explicitly answered question confirming the removal: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k amend_no_silent_drop -m safety` passes
Example responses added to kitchen/orders/fakes/http/
out_of_scope: Triggering the recheck (verdict watches ticket revisions)

tasks.title: orders: Bin profiling and chef confirmation on FakeJev
tasks.goal: Shift-start bin profiling through POST /v1/profiles/bins (kitchen/profiling/bin_labels.py) and chef confirmation through /confirm (kitchen/profiling/chef_confirm.py), writing bin_profile and opening chef confirmations for unclear ingredients.
acceptance: FakeJev.profile_bin returns an allergen_profile from label or prep-sheet text: `uv run pytest kitchen/profiling -k profile_bin_fake` passes
POST /v1/profiles/bins writes bin_profile via StateClient.put_bin_profile and returns a valid allergen_profile: `uv run pytest kitchen/profiling -k profiles_api_contract` passes

Each unclear ingredient opens one confirmation via StateClient.open_chef_confirmation; /confirm calls answer_chef_confirmation, updates the profile, and sets confirmed_by_chef only when none remain: `uv run pytest kitchen/profiling -k chef_confirm_flow` passes

A profile with open unclear ingredients is never written as confirmed_by_chef, and 'none of these' must be an explicit answer: `uv run pytest kitchen/profiling -k unclear_never_clean -m safety` passes
Example responses (including seeded open confirmations for the outputs chef screen) added to kitchen/orders/fakes/http/

tasks.title: orders: Run orders against the partner's real database
tasks.goal: Prove the send and profiling paths work with the partner's real StateClient against a local SpacetimeDB, not only the in-memory fake. Build and run the test against InMemoryStateClient first; the last step needs the partner's database/ and real StateClient.
acceptance: An integration test (marked slow) sends a ticket and reads it back through whatever StateClient the config selects; it passes on InMemoryStateClient: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -m slow -k real_state`
With the partner's real StateClient and a local SpacetimeDB set up per database/README.md, the same test passes; the PR body includes the command output
kitchen/orders/README.md documents the env vars that point orders at a local SpacetimeDB
out_of_scope: Running SpacetimeDB in CI unless platform already supports it

tasks.title: orders: Add Transcriber fake and /v1/transcribe endpoint
tasks.goal: Voice tickets work end to end on a fake: /v1/transcribe returns text from TextFileTranscriber (kitchen/orders/transcribe.py), and voice-source notes go through the same parse and question flow.
acceptance: TextFileTranscriber implements Transcriber and returns canned transcripts keyed by audio fixture: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k transcriber_fake` passes
POST /v1/transcribe accepts audio/wav and returns {"text": ...}: `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k api_transcribe` passes
A note parsed with source=voice yields parse_result.source == 'voice': `uv run pytest kitchen/orders -k parse_voice_source` passes
Example responses added to kitchen/orders/fakes/http/
